Class DefaultAsyncFunctionDiscoveryClient

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.function.client.DefaultAsyncFunctionDiscoveryClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
AsyncFunctionDiscoveryClient
@Singleton public class DefaultAsyncFunctionDiscoveryClient extends Object implements AsyncFunctionDiscoveryClient
The default AsyncFunctionDiscoveryClient, the CompletionStage counterpart of DefaultFunctionDiscoveryClient. It looks the functions up with the CompletionStages of the discovery client, without a publisher.

5.3.0

  • Method Details

    • getFunction

      public CompletionStage<FunctionDefinition> getFunction(String functionName)
      Finds a function for the given function name, among the functions this client was created with, then among the instances of the services of the discovery client, like DefaultFunctionDiscoveryClient.getFunction(String): the instances of every service are looked up at once, and the first lookup that completes with an instance that is up and that offers the function completes the stage, and stops the others. The first lookup that fails before that fails the stage, and a stage that no instance completes fails with a FunctionNotFoundException. The stages of the discovery client are not cancelled, since they may be shared, their results are ignored once the stage is complete.
      Specified by:
      getFunction in interface AsyncFunctionDiscoveryClient
